74cb8653a1971d3707c6bfd8614db10c3e5711f6.summary: A 2015 blog post by MobileIron (Michael T. Raggo, October 2015) on XARA, a group of iOS and OS X vulnerabilities reported by Indiana University researchers. It describes URL scheme hijacking, where a malicious app registers the same URL scheme as a legitimate app, intercepts inter-app requests, and can be used for phishing and credential theft. The researchers say their discoveries date back to fall 2014, and FireEye's Masque Attack II (February 2015) is cited as earlier work. Mitigations are MobileIron's AppConnect product and general iOS best practices.
